name: Malchus
role: High priest's servant whose ear was cut off
whenBasis: The crucifixion under Pilate (AD 26–36), usually dated to the Passover of AD 30 or 33 from the weekday the gospels give.
summary: The servant of the high priest whose right ear Simon Peter cut off with his sword when Jesus was arrested in the garden. Jesus told Peter to put his sword away.
body: All four gospels tell of the blow; only John names Peter and Malchus. Only Luke says Jesus touched the ear and healed him. A relative of Malchus later asks Peter in the courtyard whether he did not see him in the garden.
